verdict.rationale: The evidence covers expense receipts, expense approvals and reimbursements, plus outbound client invoicing (accounts receivable). Nothing documents capturing vendor bills, routing bill approvals, or paying vendors by ACH, check, or wire. Expense approval and AR invoicing are adjacent features and earn no credit toward an accounts-payable story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire
